steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Kanboard with username 'admin' and password '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}' (type the password text exactly as '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}' — it will be filled in when typed). After signing in, report what page you land on and any projects listed.

02-open: Open the board of the project named '{{01-signin.project_name}}' and report the names of the board's columns in their left-to-right order, exactly as shown on the board page. Only read — do not modify or move anything.

03-create: On the project '{{01-signin.project_name}}', create a new task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' with a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task created for run {{runid}}'). Fill any other required fields sensibly (leave due date unset for now, leave it in the default/first column). Submit the form and verify the task was created. Report the task's numeric ID as displayed (Kanboard shows it as #<number> on the task page) and the column it landed in.

04-verify: Move the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (task {{03-create.task_id_display}}) on project '{{01-signin.project_name}}' so that it sits in the '{{02-open.column_work_in_progress}}' column of the board. You can use the task page's move option or drag the card on the board — whichever works. Do not touch the seed tasks (titles starting 'Seed:'). Verify afterwards on the board that the task card is in the '{{02-open.column_work_in_progress}}' column, and report the column it is in.

05-add: On the task page for task {{03-create.task_id_display}} ('{{runid}} Bench Task'), add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit it and verify the comment appears on the task page. Report the comment text as displayed.

06-set: On the task page for task {{03-create.task_id_display}} ('{{runid}} Bench Task'), set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 (December 31, 2026). Use the task's edit/details form or the due-date field on the task page. Submit and verify the due date is displayed as 2026-12-31 on the task page. Report the due date exactly as displayed.

07-open: Final verification, read-only. Open the board of project '{{01-signin.project_name}}' and report: (a) the board column names left-to-right exactly as shown; (b) which column the task card '{{runid}} Bench Task' is in. Then open that task's page and report: (c) the task's numeric ID as displayed (#<number>), (d) the task {{03-create.input_textarea_select}}, (e) the description text, (f) the due date as displayed, (g) the comment text(s) shown, and (h) the column shown in the task summary. Do not modify anything.
